document.about: Hobart AM15 dishwasher specification sheet. Its model, options and accessories are lists of boxes to tick, each opening with ❑ (U+2751, a Zapf Dingbats box) set in the text run.

notes: ❑ was not read as a bullet, so the options ran together as paragraphs, and the short bold ones were taken for headings: one section per accessory.

checks.issue: #49: the accessory came out as a heading, ❑ Peg rack.
#49: the options ran together in one paragraph, each behind its box.
#49: as above; no section opens on a box.
